{{Quote|So what's wrong with being a mercenary? Is your war worth fighting? If it is, then why does it matter who fights it for you? Aren't we imbued with the righteousness of your cause when we take up arms for you? Would you rather your own men and women died to make the point? And if your war is so noble, so necessary&mdash;why aren't you fighting it yourself? Think of all that before you spit on us, aruetii.|General Jaster Mereel to the Regent of Mek va Uil|<ref name="o66" />}}
This '''individual''' who served as the Regent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mek va Uil]] lived sometime around [[62 BBY/Legends|62 BBY]]. The Regent received a rebuke from [[Mandalore (title)|Mand'alor]] [[Jaster Mereel]] regarding the Regent's negative attitude of hiring [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to fight their war.<ref name="o66" />
